posts.title: Can the Online Safety Act be fixed?
posts.description: Three years after the UK's Online Safety Act received Royal Assent, no-one is happy and the air is thick with complaints. Supporters say that implementation has been too slow, too cautious, and that the Act hasn’t made any real difference. posts.title: If the computer is not accountable, who is?
posts.description: “A computer can never be held accountable Therefore a computer must never make a management decision” So went a famous internal IBM training manual in 1979.
